exact: major coding region determinant of instability-mediated mRNA stability complex
major coding region instability determinant-mediated mRNA stability complex
major coding region instability determinant-poly(A)-bridging complex
major coding-region determinant of instability - poly(A) tail-bridging complex

definition: A protein complex that binds to, and promotes stabilization of, mRNA molecules containing the major coding region instability determinant (mCRD) by bridging the mCRD domain and the poly(A) tail of the mRNA. In human, it consists of CSDE1, HNRPD, PABPC1, PAIP1 and SYNCRIP.
label: mCRD-mediated mRNA stability complex
